tasks.short: Advise injured athletes against unsafe return

steps.what: Advise against returning to competition and explain further-injury concerns

tasks.design: Retain the personal discussion of unsafe return and next steps. The clinical record system {OTHER} supplies existing assessment context; no model makes or communicates an independent clearance decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Athletes may feel strong pressure to return despite clinical concerns.
tasks.enabler_now: Generated wording does not replace trust and checking understanding.
tasks.still_hard: Competition incentives and uncertainty can complicate acceptance of advice.
tasks.human_edge: The physician explains risks clearly and responds to individual concerns.
tasks.altitude: Return-advice responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify the practical meaning of a return restriction

evidence.claim: Retaining sensitive return-to-competition advice is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is explaining an already-assessed return concern, excluding examination, diagnosis and record production.
No free structured clearance flag or machine action is assumed.
Existing clinical tools remain; no custom system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no process change is introduced.
research_questions: Does the athlete understand the restriction and the conditions for further review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. The advice conversation retains all time; no hypothetical certificate-writing baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record care information and maintain athlete records

steps.what: Select medical care facts and capture source decisions for the record
Record care information as a clinical note draft

loop.purpose: Draft a care note from explicit physician source decisions
loop.input: Checked care-note source with patient, encounter, decisions and uncertainty
loop.output: Draft care narrative with source references and no invented findings
loop.check: Physician checks treatment, laterality, medication wording, follow-up and uncertainty against actual care decisions
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported content or unclear identity returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Test native templates and dictation first; free-text care narratives may need bounded drafting

steps.what: Check and file the final note and maintain correction history

tasks.design: Draft current medical-care notes into the clinical record system {OTHER} from the physician's checked source material. The physician validates and files each note and handles corrections; prior-history recording belongs to its separate task and earns no saving here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Care narratives require accurate transfer of clinical decisions into records.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound clinical drafting can reduce narrative composition.
tasks.still_hard: Treatment actually delivered, proposed treatment and follow-up must remain distinct.
tasks.human_edge: The physician knows whether the record faithfully represents the care provided.
tasks.altitude: Less note composition; record accountability and correction responsibility remain.

reach.task: Resolve clinical note version and correction queries

evidence.claim: Autoscriber produces clinical documentation drafts for clinician validation; this supports drafting capability rather than sports-medicine-specific savings.
The source-bound care-note adaptation and time estimate are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is current care documentation and record maintenance. Prior medical-history notes are owned by the separate history task; identical note passages must not be counted twice in roll-up.

The physician produces patient/encounter ID, source version, care decision text, delivered versus planned treatment, follow-up and uncertainty in s1. All 30 hours remain for capture or dictation. Missing facts require manual clarification, not inferred completion.
Test native templates and dictation before custom drafting; no ambient recording is required.
Allow five focal hours for template repairs and failure review beyond routine note validation and corrections.
unknowns: Overlap with history notes and existing dictation
research_questions: Does drafting shorten net care-note time while preserving delivered versus planned treatment?

already_counted.description: Source capture and final record validation

approvals.approved_version: Exact care note, patient/encounter and source snapshot; changed statements require another physician check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus5 upkeep =15 net. High assumes manual care narrative composition; low covers efficient existing dictation or full rewriting. No duplicate history-note saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Examine athletes before participation and evaluate relevant physical findings
Evaluate fitness and possible injury predisposition in the proposed sport

tasks.design: Retain direct examination and clinical participation assessment. Existing history in the clinical record system {OTHER} supports the encounter; no automated fitness score or injury-predisposition classifier is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fitness and clinical concerns depend on examination and actual sport demands.
tasks.enabler_now: Documentation technology does not replace physical assessment.
tasks.still_hard: A single examination cannot remove all uncertainty about future injury.
tasks.human_edge: The physician integrates observed findings and recognises a need for further assessment.
tasks.altitude: Examination and participation-assessment responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify sport demands relevant to a clinical assessment
reach.learn: Activity demands and clinical referral boundaries

evidence.claim: Keeping preparticipation examination and judgement human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is a distinct preparticipation encounter. If it is the same examination as the general examination task, roll-up assigns that work once; no duplicate capacity is claimed.
No free structured fitness classification or automatic clearance action is assumed.
Existing clinical records remain; no custom assessment tool is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow changes.
unknowns: Participation assessment scope and overlap with general examinations
research_questions: Which findings trigger further clinical evaluation before participation advice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Examination and judgement retain all time; no administrative screening baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess medication suitability using the injury context and patient history
Prescribe medication after checking patient-specific instructions and safety alerts

tasks.design: Retain medication selection and final prescribing in the clinical prescribing system {OTHER}. Existing medication surveillance supports review; the physician checks alerts and the exact prescription rather than delegating prescribing to a model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Medication suitability depends on the patient and concurrent treatment.
tasks.enabler_now: Established surveillance can support a check without establishing new labour savings.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete medication history and patient-specific risks require clarification.
tasks.human_edge: The physician decides whether treatment is appropriate and resolves safety concerns.
tasks.altitude: Prescribing authority and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify the clinical indication when a medication alert needs review

evidence.claim: The G-Standaard supports interaction, contraindication, dose and duplicate surveillance; this is an existing capability, not an autonomous prescribing service.
Retaining the clinical prescription decision and its time is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is the physician's medication selection, entry and release, excluding dispensing.

The physician captures and checks patient identity, medicine, strength, dose, route, schedule and indication in s2, retaining all 40 hours. Missing history or unresolved alerts require manual clarification. Existing surveillance runtime is not human labour.
Use existing native prescribing facilities; no new rule base or custom model is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is introduced. Actual authorised prescribing scope is a customer fact.
unknowns: Available prescribing support and current history quality
research_questions: Which missing medication-history details most often require clarification before release?

already_counted.description: Prescription entry, alert review and final release check

approvals.approved_version: Exact prescription, patient identity, medicine, dose, route, schedule and indication; any edit requires another physician check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Selection, capture, alert review and approval remain counted; existing surveillance runtime yields no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce current care-note composition where feasible while retaining return advice, physical screening and medication prescribing.
reach: Clarify sport demands with athletic trainers
role.ambitious_version: A sports medicine physician who keeps care records traceable and explains clinical limits clearly to athletes and colleagues.
